public_rationale: Menlo’s December 9, 2025 release reports that Anthropic’s enterprise LLM API share rose from 12% in 2023 to 40% in 2025, while OpenAI’s fell from 50% to 27%. These substantial movements support the relative-market-share claim within that market [e1]. Ramp reports that Anthropic’s business adoption quadrupled over the year through April 2026, while OpenAI’s increased slightly; this does not establish a decline in OpenAI’s customer count [e2].
limitations: Enterprise LLM API share does not measure the entire business AI market [e1].
Menlo lists Anthropic among its portfolio companies [e1].
The share and adoption figures do not establish falling OpenAI revenue or customers switching directly from OpenAI to Anthropic [e1, e2].

evidence.explanation: Menlo reports Anthropic’s enterprise LLM API share rising from 12% in 2023 to 40% in 2025, while OpenAI’s fell from 50% to 27%. Both movements are substantial under the ordinary share-based reading.

Ramp independently reports rapid Anthropic adoption growth, but a small annual increase for OpenAI. Its adoption-rate denominator differs from enterprise API market share, so it limits a customer-loss interpretation rather than contradicting the selected share-based claim.
